rules.strategy: Reuse frozen candidate/evaluate/metrics/portfolio without changing production analyzer or pending research rules. Capture proposal and both fixed controls in a separate cohort.
rules.activation: Persistent activation; prospective cohort begins next UTC midnight. Baseline existing setups for all models, including pre-cohort, first observation and after missed observations. Require breakout 4H close at/after cohort origin and uninterrupted per-market observation since before that close.
rules.signal_time: Retain signal close+1ms created_ms sentinel and actual observed_ms separately. First executable candle strictly starts after observed_ms: floor(observed_ms/15M)*15M+15M. Never use partially elapsed capture candle.
rules.expiry: Keep original signal close+4 bars proposal, +2 bars controls; observation delay never extends deadline. These live capture controls are NOT historical replay or actual production fills.
rules.pending_state: Use immutable setup identity observed before eligible candle open. No hindsight reconstruction of missed first confirmation or pending state.
rules.outcome: Closed sequential later candles only; reuse frozen fill ambiguity, same-bar TP/SL ambiguity and adverse gap logic. Missing candle or pre-fill state becomes terminal DATA_GAP; freeze uncertain capital, never impute profit.
rules.duplicates: First qualified candidate per model/setup only. Mark baseline/gap setups consumed; never rearm or backfill candidates.
rules.cohorts: Fixed non-overlapping 7-day UTC cohorts from capture origin. Partial/open/censored outcomes disclosed; never add cumulative daily snapshots.
rules.notification: None. Independent SQLite tables. No push, Telegram, UI entry cards, production paper-account orders or exchange transport.
rules.portfolio: Reuse 10000 USDC, 1% risk, 3 positions/3% total risk, 1x notional, JST 3% daily loss limit; reserve at creation without future sizing.

interpretation.sample: INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE below 20 resolved in each model/cohort; live capture is still simulated OHLC touch, not real fills.
interpretation.practicality: At least two complete independent periods >=50 resolved, win>=40%, net AvgR>0/PF>=1.2, higher costs AvgR>0/PF>1, additional fills and known positive capped ROI with >=20 capped resolved before considering further execution-quality validation. Preserve original research gates separately.
interpretation.failures: No automatic promotion or parameter tuning. Adequately sampled negative net expectation/PF<=1 requires KILL review.
limitations: Capture cohort differs conservatively from replay due to exclusion of elapsed candle and existing/unknown setups. Do not combine with historical samples.
No spread, tick, queue, funding or actual fill validation.
Missed state or candle can censor results and freeze capital; disclose coverage.
